description: List funds from the live DFM v2 API (GET /vaults) — the same filter, sort and search surface the marketplace page uses. Returns address, name/symbol, status, TVL, share price, fees, and basket allocations. Fees null with feesUnavailable:true mean the live read failed: say fees are unavailable right now, never 0. Filters: category (7 Fun, 8 RWA, 3 AI, 9 Stocks, 4 Gaming, 1 DeFi, 10 Infra, 255 custom), search (name), creator (wallet). A sector category lists the same funds as the marketplace chip: funds launched in it (7 Fun also covers the retired Meme 2), plus Custom/older funds whose holdings fall in that sector; 255 is an exact match. Also sortBy + sortDir, page, limit (max 50).
name: list_dtfs
title: List Funds
